Changsha_Xiangtan.rail_road: PARTIAL_TO_MODERATE through capacity; military trains/columns usable with recurring 14AF damage and repair windows
Changsha_Xiangtan.river: usable mainly by staged/night movement; not frictionless
Changsha_Xiangtan.air: fighter/recon tactical operations routine; medium/heavy sustained basing still below mature-node standard
Changsha_Xiangtan.administration: municipal/police/registry/rail security increasingly transferred to Nanjing cadres under Japanese key-node control
Changsha_Xiangtan.economic_extraction: LOW_TO_MODERATE; market/tax functions resume but sabotage, evacuation and requisition damage suppress immediate yield

Hengyang.Chinese_rewire: IX War Area and Fourteenth Air Force support functions shift further to Leiyang/Lingling/Kweilin/Chenzhou depth; rail stores and communications are progressively pulled south
Hengyang.Japanese_use: outer road/rail interdiction and artillery observation improve, but the decisive junction is not transferred until city defense is broken

Nanjing_rear_security.limit: Rear-security substitution enables the advance but does not eliminate Japanese responsibility for bridges, depots, airfields and mobile anti-guerrilla reserves.

network_interpretation: The campaign is transferring transport/air/admin/fiscal nodes in layers. Chinese loss of Changsha is now operationally real, but the southern network has been rewired rather than collapsed.
